description: This chart depicts the distribution of deceived conversations, broken down by degrees of ambiguity, and consists of two concentric pie charts labeled “Ambiguity 1 (Outer)” and “Ambiguity 2 (Inner).” The outer chart is divided into three slices representing categories labeled “Deceived,” “Partially,” and “Not Deceived,” colored red, yellow, and green respectively. These slices represent approximately 67.6%, 31.6%, and 10.5% of the whole, with percentage labels displayed within each slice. The inner chart also contains three slices with the same labels and corresponding colors, representing approximately 57.9%, 23.5%, and 8.8% of the whole, also with percentage labels inside each slice. A legend to the side of the chart clarifies the color-label association for both the outer and inner charts. The slices within each chart appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in clockwise order.
